The mark price will gradually converge from Pre-IPO trading Mark Price to the standard Mark Price calculation. There may be particular price volatility immediately following official listing and the share price may not ever reach the IPO price. 3.3 Mark Price After the Transition to TradFI Perp: Following the effective time specified in the Pre-IPO Transition Notice, the Mark Price will be calculated using the following formula: Mark Price = Median (Price 1, Price 2, Contract Price) Please refer to the Clearing Procedures and the Mark Price and Price Index in USDⓈ

The Tea network and TEA token facilitate a programmable reward and value exchange layer for open-source software.
